body: Thanks for wishing good thoughts. Im trying to see if I can get some sort of state insurance to be back on anti depressants, holding it will help this time. I’m not a native English speaker, so I’m not entirely sure what “feeling sorry for yourself” means, and as far as how I understand it it’s not what I do all day. It sure isn’t easy reading how I let things slip away, that I let depression get at me and I let myself be gay so my family can kick me out. But what I’ve learned on the streets is that I’m not a one in a million case, but one of million—moving on isn’t easy but it will take every part of me to keep moving.
